summary.text: Karen Rohr is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 31 since December 1, 2010 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Rohr earned a B.S. and an M.S. in nursing and nursing administration from the University of Mary and a Ph.D. in nursing research from the University of North Dakota, according to Ballotpedia.
Her professional experience includes working as a nurse practitioner, as a project coordinator and as bioethics and clinical research director at Medcenter One.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Human Services Committee and the House Government and Veterans Affairs Committee.
